{"products":[{"id":9895328,"name":"Regaine for Women","active_ingredient":"Minoxidil","active_ingredient_additional":"","dosage":2,"dosage_additional":"","dosage_unit":"% w/w","dosage_unit_additional":"","package_size":"60ml","medical_product_information":"

Each pack contains 200 mg of Minoxidil in 60ml (2%)

How to use:

Always read the patient information leaflet before use. 

Apply 1ml to affected areas on the scalp TWICE a day (maximum 2ml total a day). It can take up to 16 weeks before any growth is noticed. Continued hair growth will require continuous treatment. If there has been no improvement in 12 months do not continue to use this product.

Possible local side effects:

  • Increased initial hair shedding
  • Headache
  • Irritation at application site
  • Hypotension
  • Changes in hair colour or texture
